conventions.convention: The metric has signature (-,+,+,+); observers are future unit timelike vectors. A frame here means an observer congruence and its pointwise rest spaces, distinct from a chart or tetrad.
The state domain X is nonempty and open in (0,∞)×R, e is C², and spacetime state maps are C². Define n=1/v, s=nσ_p, ε=ne, T=e_σ_p, p=-e_v, H=e+pv, h=ε+p=nH, and μ=H-Tσ_p.

In length coordinates x⁰=ct, u and metric components are dimensionless. Geometric number, entropy and energy fluxes acquire their physical flux units by multiplication by c. Thermodynamic ε and p are not automatically identified with stress projections.
Heat-capacity positivity requires T>0 and e_σ_pσ_p>0; compressibility positivity requires e_vv>0; pressure-energy response positivity additionally requires h>0. Convexity is a separate hypothesis.

Eckart construction is pointwise for a future timelike current. Landau construction is local near a pointwise perfect-fluid tensor with ε₀+p₀>0 and yields a C¹ observer field, without global existence.
The smooth geometric suppliers inherit Countable Choice for their tangent-bundle smooth structure; no stronger choice assumption is introduced.

load_bearing.statement: Defines the C² local state function and derived thermodynamic quantities, observer rest-space projection, C¹ number and entropy currents, and C¹ symmetric stress tensor with their projections and units; imposes no conservation equations or identification of state quantities with current projections.

For the stated nonempty open state domain and C² function, dε=T ds+μ dn, ε+p=Ts+μn, and dp=s dT+n dμ. The parcel energy E=N e(V/N,S/N) is C², positively homogeneous of degree one, satisfies dE=T dS-p dV+μ dN and E=TS-pV+μN, and its Hessian annihilates the radial vector. Response and curvature conclusions retain their separately stated hypotheses.

Proves the unique observer-relative vector and symmetric-tensor decompositions, Q=0 exactly when u is a timelike eigenvector, the unique pointwise Eckart observer for future timelike J, and a unique local C¹ Landau branch near a perfect-fluid value with h₀>0. A nonzero null-dust tensor ρℓ⊗ℓ with ρ>0 has no timelike eigenvector.

published_dependencies.used_for: Smooth Lorentzian four-manifold, signature, time orientation, causal conventions and inherited choice assumption.
Future unit timelike observer, rest space and spatial projection definitions.
Smooth observer congruence, maximal observer curves and distinction from adapted charts.
Timelike curve domains, regularity, proper time and four-velocity normalization.
Smooth local frames, future orthonormal tetrads and distinction from coordinate frames.
Unique torsion-free metric-compatible connection and induced tensor derivative.
Exact inherited AC_omega convention for the geometric suppliers.
Differentiating state-coordinate changes and parcel energy compositions.
Local response-coordinate inversions and the Landau graph with invertible w-derivative h₀I.
Applying the negative-semidefinite Hessian conclusion to -e under the stated convexity hypotheses.
Orthogonal projection and positive definiteness of a timelike observer's rest space, including the null-dust obstruction.
Smooth future tetrad near the Landau construction's base point.

seams_checked.note: The units definition and material/entropy postulates preserve the supplier's signature, regularity, marker normalization and flux factors. Physical identifications and entropy admissibility are explicitly adopted premises rather than consequences of the mathematical definition.

The perfect-fluid, circulation, dissipative-entropy and first-order consumers reproduce the state definitions faithfully. Gibbs identities are used under the stated C² hypotheses; positive temperature, constitutive equations and balance laws are supplied separately. No global Landau existence or automatic conservation law is attributed to this batch.
